title: Servicing Compliance Clock
description: Computes servicer-compliance due dates and clock states from event dates and loan values across the Regulation X/Z servicing rules: error-resolution, information-request, loss-mitigation, foreclosure-timeline, force-placed-insurance, reminder, cancel, refund, payment-crediting, payoff-statement and ARM notice clocks. Every obligation carries its paragraph citation, a named business-day calendar assumption and its due window; invalid dates and over-bound event sets are refused, never computed.

rule.description: Rule id from the node's catalog, e.g. error_acknowledgment, loss_mit_evaluation, payoff_statement, arm_payment_change_notice.

trigger_date.description: Strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD event date that starts the clock. Required.

action_date.description: Optional: the date the servicer acted; without it the clock reports state within.

error_category.description: error_investigation only: one of the eleven enumerated error categories, 1-11.

request_type.description: info_request_response only: owner_identity (10 business days) or other (30).

foreclosure_sale_date.description: Optional sale date powering the 45-day and 37-day gates and the sale-bounded error window.

extension_notice_given.description: Written extension notice given before the deadline; adds 15 business days where the rule allows.

charge_date.description: Force-placed insurance: the date the premium charge is assessed.

initial_notice_date.description: Force-placed insurance reminder: the initial notice delivery date.

first_adjusted_payment_date.description: ARM notice windows: first payment due at the adjusted level.

consummation_date.description: arm_initial_adjustment_notice only: consummation date for the at-consummation case.

adjustment_frequency_days.description: ARM payment-change: uniformly scheduled adjustment interval in days; 60 or less selects the 25-day floor.

originated_before_2015_01_10.description: ARM payment-change pre-2015 short-index variant flag.

index_figure_lt_45_days.description: ARM payment-change pre-2015 variant: index figure less than 45 days old.

delinquency_date.description: foreclosure_referral_120day alias of trigger_date semantics: date the obligation went delinquent.

continuously_delinquent_since.description: no_duplicate_processing: borrower delinquent at all times since the prior complete application.

events.description: Event list, at most 32. Each event names a rule, a strict ISO trigger date, and rule-specific parameters.
